title: Launch Ops Gestalt — Readiness Journal & KPI Orchestration Cookbook
content:
Purpose:
This note is a compact, operational-first journal for the upcoming product launch wave. Treat it as the orchestration cookbook: concise decision heuristics, KPI watchpoints, owner map, and runnable traffic gating recipes. Not intended to replace the PRD (see linked_confluence) — this is the day-by-day theater guide for Product Ops + SRE + Solutions during ramp.

High-level launch objectives (gestalt):
- Deliver initial cohort to Hosted API with latency target P50 < 120ms, P95 < 450ms for short text flows.
- Keep customer-visible error rate < 0.5% across routes.
- Achieve first-week adoption retention > 40% for trial cohort.
- Control cost burn: incremental token cost < $0.35 per 1k tokens for canary phase.

Headline KPIs (baseline & thresholds):
- API latency (P50/P95) — baseline: 110/420ms; alert threshold: P95 > 550ms for >5m.
- Request error rate — baseline: 0.12%; warning: >0.5% sustained 10m; critical: >1% 5m.
- Throughput (rps) — expected steady state 850 rps; headroom guard: autoscale failsafe kicks at 1200 rps.
- Cost per 1k tokens — monitoring; if upward trend >20% vs baseline for 3 contiguous days -> cost review.
- Customer UX success (first run completions) — baseline 68%; concern if <55% for new cohort.

Readiness gates (short checklist, owners):
- Gate: Platform capacity validated under 1.5x projected burst. Owner: Jordan Kim. Criteria: load-test run 2 with KV-cache warmed, 99th percentile response under SLA. Contingency: fallback to a smaller model variant + traffic-shed.
- Gate: Security review (KMS key rotation + audit trail). Owner: Sana Iyer. Criteria: audit logs present in S3, KMS policy approved. Contingency: delay canary and run private-only beta.
- Gate: Customer comms package (how-to, FAQ, downgrade guidance). Owner: Devon Patel. Criteria: docs published + support playbook. Contingency: stunt shallow launch for internal-only testers.

Roadmap tracker (2-week cadence snapshots):
- Week 0 (pre-canary): smoke + regression tests, end-to-end telemetry wiring. Owner: Claire H. Risks: model drift on long prompts. Acceptance: regression pass + signal sanity.
- Week 1 (canary, 5% traffic): monitor KPI deltas; run manual mitigation drill. Owner: Jordan/Kim. Risk: autoscaler oscillation. Acceptance: stable metrics for 48h.
- Week 2 (ramp, 25% traffic): validate UX funnel; start cost burn analysis. Owner: Product Ops. Risk: token cost creep.
- Week 3 (full launch): deprecate older routing policy; full monitoring roster in place. Owner: Product + SRE.

Traffic gating recipe (cookbook style):
1) Canary open (5%): route hashed by user-id modulo 20 -> clients assigned to canary cohort; ensure sticky routing.
2) Metrics baseline check windows: 10m rolling windows with 5m lookback; signal types: latency P95, error rate, TPU/GPU utilization, billing delta.
3) Escalation mapping: if any signal crosses warning -> on-call slack ping + page to oncall; if critical -> immediate 75% roll-back window in 5 minutes and traffic set to 0% for cohort.
4) Ramp heuristic: linear ramp over 12 hours (5% -> 25%) if no warnings; otherwise pause and run targeted load-test for failing route.

Rollback decision tree (quick):
- Symptom: increased customer errors (>=1% 5m) -> roll to previous model variant (compatible) + reduce traffic by 80%.
- Symptom: latency P95 increase >30% baseline (10m) -> enable shorter-seq model variant & drop large prompt requests to lower tier.
- Symptom: cost per 1k tokens > threshold over 24h -> throttle low-priority batch jobs and evaluate quantized variant test (Dev PR #321).

KPI dashboard and alert routes (ops wiring):
- Dashboard layout: left column lifecycle KPIs (latency, errors, throughput), center user-experience (first-run success, retention), right cost & infra (GPU utilization, billing delta).
- Alerts: paging policy: SRE -> Product Ops -> Product PM for critical; Slack channel #launch-room for warnings.
- Sampling plan: full telemetry for canary cohort, 10% sampling for non-canary for cost controls.

Owner map (short):
- Claire Huang (product-ops): coordination, launch cadence, external comms with growth.
- Jordan Kim (sre/infra): capacity, autoscaler, load test orchestration.
- Sana Iyer (security/compliance): KMS, audit, private-deploy checklist.
- Devon Patel (product writer/CS ops): docs, onboarding flows, support runbook.

Dry-run checklist (pre-canary, quick run):
- [ ] End-to-end smoke: create test account -> issue 50 sample requests, validate outputs. (owner: Devon)
- [ ] Trace hooks: request -> runtime -> cache -> model KV present; traces sampled for P99 latency (owner: Jordan)
- [ ] Billing sandbox validated (owner: Claire)
- [ ] Support rotas loaded, escalation templates ready (owner: Devon)

Contingency play snippets (short bullets):
- Autoscaler thrash: freeze ramp after last good step, spin up dedicated smaller GPU pool for canary, fallback to older kernel.
- Model quality regression: run targeted eval set (PRD eval_026) and compare token-level divergence; if above threshold -> cut traffic and patch prompt_tuning.
- Region outage: redirect cohort to adjacent region with capacity guard; notify customers in 30m.

Open questions / notes-to-self (working):
- Should we include per-customer budget caps automatically in routing? (Follow-up: PRODOPS-459)
- UX dependency: marketing banner needs to show deprecation window for older API keys — confirm copy with growth.
- Need a short-run play to handle long prompt abuse (>=10k tokens) — throttle vs queueing decision.

Immediate TODOs (next 72h):
- Jordan: schedule canary load test 2 (warm cache scenario) and attach artifacts to JIRA ticket PRODOPS-452.
- Sana: confirm KMS rotation window won't collide with canary start.
- Devon: finalize short-form support script for rollback scenarios.

Notes (informal/fragmented):
- Keep the launch-room channel triage template pinned.
- If we see sustained cost spike tied to a single customer, escalate to AMs before public communication.
- Remember: small-model fallbacks must preserve semantic parity for critical customer flows (billing & auth).

Appendix: quick signal thresholds (copyable):
- latency_p95_warning = baseline_p95 * 1.25
- latency_p95_critical = baseline_p95 * 1.5
- error_rate_warning = 0.5%
- error_rate_critical = 1.0%

End of journal entry.

Revision history: 2025-01-07 initial draft (Claire H). 2025-01-20 updated ramp heuristic (Jordan). 2025-02-02 added rollback cookbook snippets & open questions (Devon + Sana).
